newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia oil workers flee unstable rig.
newsitem.headline: Australia oil workers flee unstable rig.

text.p: Some 35 oil workers were forced to flee a rig off the coast of South Australia on Saturday when it shifted on the unstable sea floor, a spokesman for the company in charge of the rig said.
The workers were taken off by lifeboat.
The 50-metre tall rig was being installed when one of the three legs hit unstable ground and it started to list, said the spokesman for oil company Canyon Pty Ltd.
Spokesman Chris Rann said it was not known whether the rig, the first of two planned installations in the Gulf of St Vincent valued at A$15 million ($11.9 million), would have to be abandoned.
Canyon is an affiliate of U.S. oil and gas exploration company Wagner and Brown.
